title: TypeScript is being ported to Go | interview with Anders Hejlsberg
summary: An interview with Anders Hejlsberg, lead architect of TypeScript, about porting the TypeScript compiler to Go. He covers the 10x type-checking speedup, lower memory use, and why Go was chosen.
why: HN points to it as the authoritative answer to why the team picked Go rather than C# or Rust, citing timestamps on cyclic data structures and garbage collection.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages
